prompt: Which Linux user does vsftpd use to perform file system operations for anonymous FTP users?
choices: The Linux user `root`, restricted to globally readable/writable files
The Linux user that runs the vsftpd process
The Linux user that owns the root FTP directory
The Linux user with the same name used to log in anonymously
The Linux user specified in the configuration option `ftp_username`
explanation: Anonymous access maps to the account named by `ftp_username` (default `ftp`).
